translations.web: if the men of my tent have not said, ‘Who can find one who has not been filled with his meat?’
translations.bsb: if the men of my house have not said, ‘Who is there who has not had his fill?’—
translations.kjv: If the men of my tabernacle said not, Oh that we had of his flesh! we cannot be satisfied.
translations.asv: If the men of my tent have not said, Who can find one that hath not been filled with his meat?
